title: 有馬記念の後に・Das Versprechen

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pant… Huff!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I lost… However!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So this is the toll a long absence from racing takes on one's body. I'll have to make further adjustments to my training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Does this mean you'll be participating in races seriously next year?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm planning to do the same. I'll be happy to do so just to get another chance to race with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Spare me the flattery. There are plenty of racers who can entertain you besides me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You mean the juniors? You're not wrong. There is beauty in these up-and-comers.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash—you're a strong one. I'm interested to see what the future holds for you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I showed great potential during this race. There's room for me to grow yet.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will get solid results in my senior year. And then…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will become someone I can be proud of…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sigh…
choice_data_list: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …I'm fine. I admit that was a fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But at the moment, I would prefer words of encouragement rather than concern.
choice_data_list: You did really well against such strong opponents.
You did really well against such strong opponents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you. The strength of my competitors far exceeded my expectations… but I still managed to show off what I am capable off.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: After such a ferocious battle, I am ever more confident that I am on the correct path…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Per my original plan, I wish to run G1 races during my senior year as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Which means my first hurdle will be the Senior Spring Triple Crown's opening race, the Osaka Hai.
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer… It just occurred to me, but…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Alles in Ordnung—it means "all is well."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I had anticipated for the senior racers to be strong, but even so, I have been able to progress along my path.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What's more, I even achieved victory in that race. The races next year should not be as much of a struggle as today's so long as I continue to improve.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I wonder… Is it too soon to believe I can complete the rest of my schedule?
choice_data_list: I believe you can.
I believe you can.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt… Bzzzzt…
choice_data_list: Go ahead and take that call.
Go ahead and take that call.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ja, hallo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash starts talking to who I assume are her parents when suddenly…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Wirklich?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My mother and father are planning to come to Japan to watch me race!
choice_data_list: That's great!
That's great!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It is! I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But this is truly a shock. My parents are both extremely busy and systematic people.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Even their visit to see my tryouts was made only after I decided to study abroad.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In fact, I believe they must have made this decision long ago…
choice_data_list: They must really want to see you race.
They must really want to see you race.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Indeed. My parents said so themselves.
choice_data_list: When are they coming?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: They've apparently made time to come during the latter half of October next year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I run through Eishin Flash's schedule in my head and line up the dates.
choice_data_list: They'll be here for the autumn Tenno Sho, then!
They'll be here for the autumn Tenno Sho, then!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll have to train accordingly to be in peak condition for then.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I must keep my promise…
choice_data_list: What promise?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I just promised to show my parents how much I have grown.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I said I will run the perfect race before them and that I'll win every race along the way until that point.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I told them that I will not know defeat in my senior year.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I promised them too much…
choice_data_list: Winning everything has been my plan from the beginning.
Winning everything has been my plan from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Let's keep that promise!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will send my parents the race details.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A thought occurs to me as I see Eishin Flash off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Quite a few Umamusume who made a name for themselves in their generation have become active in races again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The question is, why? I don't have an answer, but I can't help but feel unsettled as things lead up to the Osaka Hai…
